QuestInfo.name: What Sen wants to eat
QuestInfo.1: I ran into Nina who was thinking about what to make for Dinner for her brother, Sen. I have to go and talk to Sen who is next to Nina, and find out what he wants to have for dinner.
QuestInfo.2: I asked Sen, Nina's brother, what he wants to have for dinner. He answers he wants to have a #bMushroom Soup#k.

0.0: Ah, an Explorer! Great timing! There's a #bhouse with a yellow roof#k to the east of here. You already knew about it? I thought you were new around here...

yes.0: That's my home. Ask #b#p9201192##k what he wants for dinner tonight. You can enter by pressing #bup#k in front of the door.
yes.1: You think he wants mushroom soup? Not a chance! He never wants mushroom soup!

npc.0: Haven't met #p9201192# yet? Please, open you eyes!
